fixed.how: New notesPersons(ctx, note) and saidInLine(line, note) in packages/commands/src/commands/shared.ts. A note is the person's when the actor is the person on their own command, or when the turn is chat or voice and the note's words appear together and in order in the person's own line (ctx.wordsUsed, which the stored card context keeps across a restart). The words must not come within 4 words after a turning word of the same clause, such as don't, without or nicht. task.ts's noteClause, noteGoes, queued-note author and notedByAgent all use it, and request.ts's ask read-back does too. moveAsCardAnswer (task.ts) answers a redirected move with the card's note-taking option and the person's note (not read back). On an option that takes no note, the person's note keeps the move so their words are kept, except on a high-risk card. The bench stand-in gains FORERUNNER_BENCH_CHAT_NOTE, which makes the chat model add a note it made up. A note written in a 'tool:' line is in the person's line.

If the model adds a note of its own, the read-back names it and the Yes says 'The note ...'.
